title: Brand Settings Schema
description: Schema for {brand}-settings.yaml (e.g. zqk-settings.yaml). Per-project or per-CLI-instance settings: path config, staleness check dirs, optional path alias overrides. Used by path resolution and zqk use.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file, e.g. https://zqk.dev/schemas/brand_settings.schema.json

description.description: Human-readable description of this settings file

version.description: Settings schema version (semantic versioning) for evolution and default generation

paths.description: Path-related options. All paths are relative to project root unless noted.

project_root.description: Optional override for project root (absolute path). If unset, project root is resolved from cwd or .zqk/current_root

staleness_check_dirs.description: Paths (relative to project root) checked for mtime when deciding if path alias cache is stale. Defaults if unset: [.zqk, .zqk/config]

aliases.description: Optional alias -> relative path overrides merged into the path alias cache (e.g. custom_docs: docs/custom)

default_context.description: Default context profile when not set by --context or env

binary_path.description: Optional explicit path to the CLI binary for scheduler/run_wrapper subprocess execution. May be absolute or project-root relative.

kernel_state.description: Knowledge Kernel tip snapshot (system-state.csnap) and external prior backups for state-commit

snapshot_backup_dir.description: Directory for prior tip .csnap copies (absolute, ~/…, or relative to project root). Default when unset: <parent>/<repo>-csnap-backups

snapshot_backup_keep.description: How many prior tip .csnap files to retain in snapshot_backup_dir (default 3 when unset)
